Commentary.Commentary: The pitch is on the slower side and runs off the new ball inside the Powerplay seem to be crucial. Sri Lanka would like to take advantage of the field restriction but at the same time they will have to preserve wickets. Promises to be an exciting chase, do join us in a short while.

The death bowling specialist, Lasith Malinga showed no rustiness in his comeback game and was once again in his elements. He grabbed Head and Turner off consecutive balls in the 19th over which in a way cost Australia a few runs in the end. However, Faulkner's late cameo came at the right time for them.

Aaron Finch and debutant Michael Klinger had a good game with the bat but both of them got out in quick succession to hamper the momentum. Travis Head played a good knock but he kept losing partners at the other end. Moises Henriques and Ashton Turner played brisk knocks to add vital runs to the total.

52/4 in the last five and Australia have managed to take their final total beyond the 150-run mark. The hosts, however, will be disappointed with the runs they have managed on the board after a great start provided by their openers. Credit should be given to the Sri Lankan bowlers, especially Seekkuge Prasanna, who in spite of going wicketless, bowled very tidily to frustrate the batsmen in the middle overs.

FOUR! A good finish to the innings by James Faulkner. Full toss as Faulkner flicks it over mid-wicket. The fielder out in the deep makes a horrible mess of it, doesn't get behind the ball and it spins away from him to meet the fence. AUSTRALIA END ON 168/6!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Big hitting, Pat Cummins arrives in the centre.

OUT! Paine sacrifices himself for the greater good. Wanted to get Faulkner back on strike, he got the job done but lost his wicket in the process. This full ball is hit down to long on by James. Immediately calls for the second as the throw comes in towards the bowler. Paine dives back in but the bails have been taken off. And replays show that he's gone.
A run out appeal against Tim Paine is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Wide! Fires it way down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.

That's some excellent running between the wickets. James Faulkner turns this through mid-wicket and the Aussie pair runs hard. There's a direct hit at the bowler's end but Tim Paine was easily back in for the second.
Big swing and a miss! Shortish in length, angling in, Faulkner pulls but misses.

FOUR! Great awareness from James Faulkner. He knows where the fielders are and picks his spot well. Banged in short and outside off, Faulkner makes room and cuts it over short third man. There's no protection out in the deep as the ball races away to the boundary line.
Just... So close. Spears in a yorker on middle, Faulkner manages to dig it out towards mid-wicket for one.
Tim Paine comes into the attack. But it will be James Faulkner to face the hat-trick ball as the batsmen crossed.

OUT! Two in two for Malinga. Low full toss dipping in on leg, Turner makes room and lofts it over mid-wicket. Prasanna is the man out there and once again he takes a good catch, running across to his right.
James Faulkner is in next.

OUT! Travis Head is out of here. It's full and outside off, Head lofts it over the covers. He makes decent connection but it's a big boundary out there. He cannot clear the boundary and it's a good catch taken by Prasanna just inside the ropes.
Another one of the fuller side, Head clears his front leg and lofts it over mid on. Takes two more.
Arrowed in a full delivery on middle and leg, driven towards mid on for one.

A bit comical from Seekkuge Prasanna. Ashton Turner turns it towards deep backward square leg. Prasanna collects the ball, attempts to throw it back in but spills it just as he's doing so. Luckily for him, he only concedes an extra run. Two taken.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They manage to come back for the second.
Full ball around off, it's driven to mid on for a single.

What happened there? The umpire calls the Sri Lankan skipper and has a chat. It's once again regarding the fielders inside the ring. Actually, what is happening is that one fielder is taking the start from outside the ring and isn't inside the 30-yard circle at the time of delivery.
Low full toss outside off, cut away towards the point region for a run.
No harm done! Banged in on a shorter length, angling in on middle and off, Turner can only pull it through square leg for just the one.
Free Hit coming up now...

No ball! Way down the leg side, Turner looks to flick but misses. But wait, the umpire waits to consult with the square leg umpire as he was about to signal a wide. Signals it as a no ball though as he finds some problem with the field set-up. Only three inside the circle when there should have been four as per the rules. Basic mistake from the Sri Lankan skipper, there.
Shortish length delivery, outside off, Ashton Turner drags the pulls to mid-wicket. Didn't exactly middle it but it was enough to fetch him a brace.
Length delivery angled across, Travis swings wildly across the line, looking to probably clear the boundary but gets it off the inside half on the leg side for one run.
Nuwan Kulasekara is back into the attack as well.
Low full toss on off, it's hit away to long off for a single.
Malinga once more searches for the inswinging yorker, Turner goes deep inside his crease, makes some room and works it away to mid-wicket for a run.
Full toss around off, Head slogs it straight to the mid-wicket fielder. But since the fielder is right at the edge of the circle it allows the southpaw to get off strike.
On a fuller length and shaping in, it's turned away to the on side for a run.

FOUR! Excellent yorker and that's equally well played. Nothing much Malinga can do about that, he did everything right but the placement was just too good. On middle and leg, swinging in, Turner digs it out through backward square leg and sends it across the ropes for a boundary.
Coming in on middle and leg, Ashton Turner works it through mid-wicket and some good running allows him to come back for the second.
Lasith Malinga is back to bowl at the death.

SIX! THAT'S A BIG, BIG HIT! Monstrous from Travis Head. It's served to him on a good length, he positions himself well and with all his might, muscles the slog over the mid-wicket boundary for half a dozen. It goes a long way into the stands, the fielder in the deep can do nothing but watch.
Wide! Fired way, way outside off, it's signalled as a wide.
The batsman has hit it through mid-wicket off the inside half of the bat. They manage to come back for the second.

Some athletic action from Sanjaya. He firstly fires it in the blockhole and gets it hit back in his direction. He dives in his followthrough to stop it first. It parries back towards the striker's end as the batsmen set off. He charges to the ball and dives to underarm it at the stumps but misses. One run completed.
Takes the pace off this one and bowls it on a length, Turner works it towards mid-wicket and runs through for a couple.
Fired in full and well outside off, Head walks down a couple of steps and drills it to the long off fielder for a single.
Debutant Ashton Turner walks in next.

OUT! HENRIQUES HOLES OUT! Full delivery and it's in the slot, Henriques lofts this towards long on. Doesn't get the elevation on it and it's straight down the throat of Kapugedera who makes no mistake in taking that. Another wicket down for the hosts.
Vikum Sanjaya comes back into the attack.

A complete contrast from the previous delivery, excellent work out in the field from the fielder. Shorter in length around off, Head pulls it away over mid-wicket. A good diving save from the fielder ensures that the ball does not go across the rope. Keeps the batsmen down to two.

Poor from the Lankans there. Wrong 'un outside off, Moises gives the charge in an attempt to go big once again but can only manage to edge it. It goes right through the two fielders at backward point and short third man, who arguably should have done better. The Australian batsmen take three runs. The replays showed that the backward point fielder could have done better there and Malinga actually was foxed by the spin on the ball.

SIX! Lovely shot! Tossed up from Sandakan, Henriques has made up his mind early here. He skips down the track, gets to the pitch and launches this straight through the line. Hits it dead straight back down the ground and sends it sailing over the fence for a biggie. Terrific shot.
Full around off, Head drives it through mid off and picks up a run.

In the air... But it's just short! Sandakan tosses it up outside off, Henriques goes inside out but doesn't connect well at all. It lobs over covers as Sanjaya comes running in from the deep. Puts in a dive forward but the ball just falls short of him. Goes through him which allows the batsmen to take three.
Flat ball, on a fullish length on middle, it's slog swept through mid-wicket for a run.
Lakshan Sandakan comes back into the attack.
Low full toss hurled just outside off, Travis Head gets it off the inside half past the diving short mid-wicket fielder and picks up a single to end the over. 100 up for Australia!
Malinga once again goes for the yorker but just misses his mark, it becomes an overpitched delivery which is driven to long off by Moises Henriques. A single is taken.
Quite full, aiming the base of off stump, drilled back down the ground by the left-hander to long off for one run.
Spears it full, outside off, Head leans into it and lofts it over the covers. Clears the infield with ease as he gets a couple of runs to his name.
Another slower full toss, it's a little high this time, it's hit back down to long on by Henriques for a comfortable run.
Wide! Full and going way down leg, wide called by the umpire.
An attempted slower yorker which misses, ends up bowling a low, slow full toss on middle, Henriques drives it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Lasith Malinga is back into the attack.
Fired on the pads, it's flicked through mid-wicket and a single is taken as the fielder out in the deep collects it.
Travis Head leans forward to this fuller length ball and pushes it to long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, cut straight to point. Dot ball.
Darts it just back of a driving length, Moises Henriques clips it through the mid-wicket area for one.
Pushed quicker through the air outside off, driven through covers for a single.

DROPPED! And it's by the Lankan skipper himself. Such a bad time to drop a catch, had he taken that, the entire complexion of the game would have changed. Short, flat and wide outside off, Travis Head rocks back and cuts it in the air straight to Tharanga at backward point. He though spills it and laughs in astonishment. He's going to hope that doesn't come back to bite him.
Seekkuge Prasanna returns to the attack.
Travis Head brings his wrists into play and easily works it through to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full once more from Asela Gunaratne, it's eased back down to long on for a single. Henriques is off the mark, wasting no time in doing so.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Head works it in front of mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Moises Henriques arrives at number 4.

OUT! Finch is gone! The search for the boundary sees him walk back to the dugout. Gunaratne, who showed good form against the Proteas, has carried it here and done well with the ball too. Full and a cutter on the stumps, Aaron Finch gets low to play the big slog sweep. Gets a big top edge which balloons towards Malinga at short fine leg. He runs in a few paces and takes a good catch.
Short and coming into the body, it's pulled over mid-wicket by the Aussie skipper for a couple of runs. Probably wants to score as much as possible before Malinga comes back at the death.

SIX! Welcome into the attack, mate! Finch invites Gunaratne in the worst possible fashion for the bowler. It's full on middle and leg, Aaron clears his front leg and smokes this high and handsome into the stands over the long on fence for a maximum.
Asela Gunaratne is introduced into the attack. He's fresh from a century in South Africa and that probably will give him confidence to do well with the ball also.

Not out! No, he hasn't. Comfortably safe, there. Sandakan darts it full and flat well outside off, Travis Head looks to drill this away on the off side but is beaten as Dickwella whips the bails off. He feels the southpaw has dragged his back leg out a bit and wants the umpire to take it upstairs. The decision is looked at by the third umpire and the replays show that Travis is safe.
Stumping appeal! It's referred upstairs. Did Head drag his back leg outside the crease?
Full on leg, Head misses his attempted flick shot and gets hit on the pads.
Looped up and attacking the stumps, Travis Head wrists it through wide mid on for a couple of runs.
Travis Head is in next. He's a very promising lad and is taking big steps in the shorter formats for Australia. Would like to play an impact knock today.

OUT! KLINGER DEPARTS! Went for the big shot but did not connect well at all. Tossed up around off, Michael Klinger looks to slog it hard over mid-wicket but ends up getting it off the top edge. It lobs over to Lasith Malinga at short third who takes it comfortably by stretching forward. The pressure applied by the Lankan bowlers has done the trick.
Floats this one up around off, Finch kneels down to sweep it away but gets it off the pads on the off side. A leg bye is taken.
Shorter, flatter and going across the batsman, Finch cuts it away straight to short third man for no run.
Shorter and outside off, Finch gets back again and this time punches it through point for one. We have reached the half-way mark and Australia are 75/0!

SIX! Ho! Ho! Ho! Can I call it 2-1 in favour of the batsman? Finch wins this mini battle here. Prasanna gets shorter and on middle, Aaron pushes himself deep inside the crease and launches it over the bowler's head for a maximum. Lovely to watch, this contest!
Well, well, well... Some mind games here. This time the bowler pulls out at the last second. 1-1 as the score stands.
The batsman pulls out at the last second as the bowler tries to rush through his delivery.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Aaron goes hard at it and mistimes his shot back to the bowler. Prasanna collects the ball and gives a stare.
Floated on middle, Finch tries to slog but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Whoa! Finch brings out a switch hit but fails to make any connection. Tossed up ball and outside leg, Finch ends up swinging and missing the ball completely.
Flighted and full outside off, Klinger advances down the track, tries to go over covers maybe, but mistimes it down through mid off for a single.
Walks down the track to a full ball and flicks it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and shorter outside off, turning the other way, Klinger rocks back to cut but is beaten for probably pace.
Flighted on off, driven straight to extra cover.
Goes on the back foot and punches it straight down to Vikum at long off. This time he makes no mistake and only one run is taken.

Loopy full ball outside off, Klinger lifts it over the infield at covers and crosses for a run. The long off fielder, Sanjaya, charges towards the ball and then misfields to allow two extra runs. Poor from the debutant!
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
1000 T20I runs for Aaron Finch! Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Rare bad delivery today by Prasanna, serves a low full toss around leg, Finch gets back and whips it off his pads through mid-wicket for a boundary.

Stumping chance missed! Smart bowling by Prasanna. He sees the charge from the batsman and bowls it full and wide outside off. Klinger swings and misses but Dickwella also fails to collect the ball. Michael drags his bat inside the crease. Since the ball has deflected towards short fine leg off the keeper's gloves, Finch calls him through for a bye.
Gets on the back foot and punches a shortish ball through covers for a single.
Full floated on off, driven through wide mid off for a single.
Flattish and on middle, the batsman tried flicking after getting down the track but missed and was hit on the pads.
Floated full ball on off, nudged through vacant mid-wicket region for a couple of runs as the bowler ran after it. The long on fielder eventually stopped the ball.
Gets back and hits it away through extra cover again for one.
Spinning the other way, a touch short again, it's stroked through extra cover for a run. 50 up for Australia!
Flatter and shorter outside off, cut from the back foot to short third man.
Shortish and on off, punched down to long off for a run.
Loopy full ball on off, Finch plays a premeditated paddle towards backward square leg for a single.
Lakshan Sandakan, the Chinaman, is brought into the attack now. He has a slip in place for Aaron Finch.
Top class over! Flighted and full around off, Klinger gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler. Only 4 runs off the over, 47/0 at the end of the Powerplay!
Shortish and on off, Finch moves back to slap it through the line towards the cover-point fielder. One run added to the total.
Once again Klinger fails to middle his flick shot. It goes off the inside half to square leg and they cross for one.
Loopy and around leg, Klinger gets down the track for a big shot but fails to connect and is hit on the pads.
Flighted leg spinner on off, 81.8 kph, Klinger gets forward and defends it to the off side.
Mid on drops back...
Wide! Slips one down the leg side, Klinger fails to get any bat behind it.
Flatter and shorter, following the batsman down the leg side, Finch still manages to punch it to the left of the cover fielder for a single.
Seekkuge Prasanna will roll his arm now.
Slower delivery, Finch closes the face of the bat and forces it towards wide mid on. They cross for a sharp single as once again the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. 16 runs off the over!
Length ball on middle, straighter in line, Klinger helps it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Debutant is motoring! This time Vikum overdoes his length. Goes full and around leg, Michael deflects it neatly off his pads to the fine leg boundary.
FOUR! Sanjaya goes short this time with his length but his pace is not enough to trouble the batsman, Klinger easily bosses the bounce and pulls it firmly behind square leg for a boundary.

Full in length and on middle and leg, Finch picks it off his pads and chips it over mid-wicket. The fielder gives the chase from the circle and the mid on fielder also goes after it. The latter reaches first and slides to parry the fielder running behind him. The tag team effort saves one run for the team.
Fuller and straighter, eased through mid-wicket and ran three. Superb running between the wickets. It's a big ground and there are wide gaps in the field.
Fires it very full and in the line of the stumps, Klinger digs it out through backward point for one.
FOUR! Kulasekara lets out another slower delivery, on a fuller length and around off, Klinger spots the variation early, waits for it and then lifts it just over Tharanga at mid off for a boundary.
Gets forward and nudges it in front of mid on for a run. The fielder sends a wayward throw at the non-striker's end and luckily there is a fielder backing it up.
On a length around off, Klinger stays back and pushes it towards mid off for another quick single. This time he has a shy at the keeper's end but once again fails to find the target.
Drops it fuller and on off, Finch drives it from the crease to mid off and crosses for a brisk single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Slower one, full and on middle, Finch gets deep inside the crease and punches it towards extra cover. Sandakan stationed there dives to his right to stop the ball from racing away. Good effort.
On a length and around off, pushed off the back foot to covers. 6 runs off the first over by Sanjaya!

FOUR! Much better this time by the debutant! Vikum bowls it full and around off, Klinger waits for it to come into him, leans forward and across to flick it with beautiful timing through wide mid on for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! A speedy delivery, shortish and around off, Klinger decides to pull it across the line but is early into his shot.
Better line and length this time, fuller around off, angling in, Klinger gets forward and drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Once again targets the middle stump line, on a length, Aaron gets back and turns it through mid-wicket for one.
Starts with an angled delivery, on a good length around middle, Klinger gets back and works it to the left side of the short fine leg fielder. They pick up a single.
The debutant, Vikum Sanjaya, will bowl now. Will be interesting to see how he fares here today...
This one is a little too straight from the bowler, Finch eases it off his pads through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep has to cover good ground and it allows the batsmen to take a couple of runs.

FOUR! Kulasekara errs this time, lets out a friendly full toss on middle, Finch accepts the gift gleefully and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Nuwan probably once again was eyeing the blockhole area but failed to land it.
Hits the blockhole around off, Finch moves back to make some space but only manages to dig it out to covers. Good tidy line and length from Nuwan!
Bowls it around off, a touch short and Aaron punches it from the back foot to covers.

Angles in a full length ball on off, 127.3 kph, Klinger decides to give the charge and then pats it down softly in front of cover-point for a run. Given Kulasekara's pace, the keeper should be standing up to the stumps.
A touch short and outside off, not much pace, Klinger rocks back and cuts it towards point.
Nuwan 'Swinga' Kulasekara will bowl from the other end. He makes the new ball move around and will be looking to use his strength to get an early wicket for his side.
Full in length and outside off, Klinger plays a good looking square drive and finds the gap. That's his strong zone. Three runs added to the total.
On a length and outside off, gets it to swing back in a touch, Klinger gets back and taps it down to backward point. Denies the single after taking a start as the fielder reaches the ball quickly.
Debutant is away! A leg sidish delivery, full in length and Klinger nudges it through square leg for a couple of runs. He will be a relieved man now. All those butterflies would have settled down.

Good line by Malinga, a touch short and just outside off, Finch rises on the back foot and bunts it towards mid on. This time his partner responds to the call for a single and Aaron completes it with a dive to the other end.
Miscommunication but no harm done! Good length ball on middle, Finch gets back and taps it down on the leg side. He looks for a run but his partner sends him back.
Starts with a fuller length ball on leg, Finch tries to flick but probably is beaten for pace. It comes off his pads and rolls on the leg side.

We are all set to get underway as both teams along with the umpires make their way out into the middle. It will be Aaron Finch and Michael Klinger to open the innings for Australia. 'Slinga Malinga' to kick things off for the Lankans. He has a slip in place. Here we go...

Sri Lanka XI - Niroshan Dickwella(w), Upul Tharanga(c), Dilshan Munaweera, Asela Gunaratne, Vikum Sanjaya, Chamara Kapugedera, Seekkuge Prasanna, Milinda Siriwardana, Nuwan Kulasekara, Lakshan Sandakan, Lasith Malinga.
Australia XI - Aaron Finch(c), Michael Klinger, Travis Head, Moises Henriques, Ashton Turner, Tim Paine(w), James Faulkner, Pat Cummins, Adam Zampa, Billy Stanlake, Andrew Tye.

SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD FIRST! They have one player, Vikum Sanjaya, making his international debut. Australia have three debutants - Michael Klinger and Ashton Turner, who are also making their international debuts while Billy Stanlake is handed a T20I debut.

The Aaron Finch-led side will have a lot of new faces, all of whom who will itching to make an impact. They are going to have their hands full though against a Lankan team, which is completely different in the shortest format. Lasith Malinga's return will only bolster them and will serve as a fear factor for the opposition. Will be an interesting contest surely. Stay tuned for the toss.

Hello and a warm welcome, ladies and gents, for the first game of the 3-match T20I series between Australia and Sri Lanka which is going to take place at the MCG. The good folks Down Under will be excited for this, but will have one eye on their smartphones as their best players are playing a warm-up game in India, in preparation for upcoming series against Virat Kohli's men.
